snippet.title: Isopod: A Webbed Spin-off | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Exclusively revealing a release date of October 21, 2025 for Isopod: A Webbed Spinoff from Queensland’s Sbug Games! Roll, zip, and slam your way through the gorgeous landscapes of the Queensland bush as a tiny pill-bug, unite your fellow crawlies, and fight back the greedy Fire Ant Conglomerate.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053910/Isopod_A_Webbed_Spinoff/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
